title: Exploratory Machine Learning Modeling of Adaptive and Maladaptive Personality Traits from Passively Sensed Behavior.
summary: In a 128-person sensor-data subset, trait prediction was modest and did not consistently beat the mean baseline; selected behavioral patterns were associated with trait variants. The analysis is exploratory; associations do not establish personality mechanisms or generalize beyond the sampled cohort. PsyArXiv posted the result on 2021-07-30; the peer-reviewed journal version appeared 2022-02-24. The date is the first located result-bearing preprint; the later peer-reviewed journal version is linked separately.
ai_technology: Random-forest and XGBoost models used person/day-level smartphone and wearable features; feature ranking and association-rule mining examined links to adaptive and maladaptive personality traits.
